children.text: The beginning of the shopping scene reveals Marie Antoinette's novelty and teenage instincts. A big close up shot and panning of a range of shoes. This emphasises that Maria Antoinette is in a position of luxury as well as the novelty of materialism.

This big close up shot of Marie Antoinette’s feet while trying on luxurious shoes with the Converse sneakers in the background emphasises that Maria is young and an inexperienced queen who takes pleasure in consumerism, revealing the human nature of teenage girls.
